records.label: spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores#1
records.source: Reads the measurement store selected by ``measurement_backend`` from :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, merges the object feature tables selected by ``tables`` using their existing parent-object joins, uses the wells marked as ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (or an annotation column) as training labels, delegates fitting to :func:`ml_analysis`, and writes per-object predictions, permutation and feature-importance tables plus a plate heatmap into ``results/`` under the first source folder.
records.context: Reads the measurement store selected by ``measurement_backend`` from :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, merges the object feature tables selected by ``tables`` using their existing parent-object joins, uses the microplate sample positions marked as ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (or an annotation column) as training labels, delegates fitting to :func:`ml_analysis`, and writes per-object predictions, permutation and feature-importance tables plus a laboratory microplate heatmap into ``results/`` under the first source folder.
records.translation: ``measurement_backend`` 설정으로 선택한 :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` 의 측정 저장소를 읽고, ``tables`` 설정으로 선택한 객체 특성 테이블을 기존 부모 객체 조인으로 결합합니다. ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` 표시가 있는 웰 또는 주석 열을 학습 레이블로 사용하고, 적합을 :func:`ml_analysis` 함수에 맡기며, 객체별 예측과 순열 및 특성 중요도 테이블, 플레이트 히트맵을 첫 번째 원본 폴더 아래의 ``results/`` 경로에 씁니다.

records.source: ``tables`` (list or tuple) — unique registered object-table names, optionally including ``png_list``; at least one object table is required. When absent, reads ``cell``, ``nucleus``, ``pathogen`` and ``cytoplasm`` in that order. Selected tables retain the shared reader's existing joins and nucleus/pathogen limits.
